args.title: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter + linked article & companion — summary
args.body:
- Newsletter (Saltmarsh Foods, "Retail returns logistics"): this week's theme is retail returns logistics, pointing readers to the full article and to a related webinar.
- Linked article (blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns): apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidating returns into centralized hubs cut handling costs by about a fifth (20%).
- Companion piece (insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion): resale of returned goods within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
